invariants.rationale: Commit operations are typically associated with a valid non-empty instantTime identifying the commit instant.
Committing usually implies there is at least one WriteStatus to commit.
The commit action type should be a specified non-empty string to correctly carry out the commit.
Partition to replaced file ids map should be provided (may be empty, but not null) for file replacement tracking.
Option values like extraMetadata should not be null, ensuring Option API contract is followed.
